blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A 22-year-old virtual assistant was arrested in Guiguinto, Bulacan, for allegedly forcing his “girlfriends” to conduct sexual acts in a livestreaming platform with foreign viewers, according to the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI). Two supposed ex-girlfriends of the suspect filed the complaint before the NBI, leading operatives to conduct an entrapment operation and arrest him in his apartment in Guiguinto on Thursday, Nov. 26.
